responsibility: This header centralizes the Rust frontend's canonical enumeration of source-level operator kinds. It defines the stable categories for unary negation/logical not, arithmetic and bitwise binary operators, comparison operators, lazy boolean operators, and compound-assignment operators, with comments tying many values to the corresponding Rust trait methods in `std::ops` or `std::cmp`. Its role is to give lexer/parser/AST and later semantic-lowering code a shared backend-neutral vocabulary for representing and dispatching Rust operator semantics without embedding raw tokens or trait names throughout the frontend.
